title: Customize Gemini using AGENTS.md files (Android Studio)
relevance_note: Describes deterministic discovery order and inline import mechanism for AGENTS.md guidance in an IDE agent, including precedence with GEMINI.md.
reason_included: Primary-source specification of how an agent ingests and prioritizes multiple instruction files (scan parents; prepend as preamble; GEMINI.md precedence).

claim_snippets.claim_text: If `GEMINI.md` and `AGENTS.md` exist in the same directory, `GEMINI.md` takes precedence.
Gemini scans the current directory and all parent directories for `AGENTS.md` files when you submit a query.
Gemini automatically scans current and parent directories for `AGENTS.md` files and adds their content to the beginning of every prompt as a preamble.
AGENTS.md can import other markdown files using `@` followed by supported relative or absolute paths (e.g., `@./file.md`, `@../file.md`, `@/absolute/path/to/file.md`).
